name: DotTabs
description: Snooze tabs, keep notes and tasks per site. Saved as plain files on your own disk.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http:; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
